newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ATHLETICS-BULGARIAN ATHLETIC FEDERATION CHIEFS RESIGN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BULGARIAN ATHLETIC FEDERATION CHIEFS RESIGN.

text.p: Leaders of the Bulgarian Athletic Federation have resigned because they cannot raise funds to train their athletes, newspapers reported on Friday.
A new 14-member executive board of the federation will be elected on December 11. More than 50 coaches and athletes had urged the board to step down.
"We wanted the resignation of the chiefs because at this stage they cannot find funds to prepare for competitions," top coach Georgi Dimitrov told 7 Days Sport newspaper.
